requirements.title: Basic Electron template generates correctly
requirements.description: When an operator selects the basic template, the generator shall produce an Electron project with its main process, preload bridge, package manifest, TypeScript configuration, splash page, and assets.

requirements.title: Advanced Electron template with system tray and shortcuts
requirements.description: When an operator selects the advanced template, the generator shall include the configured system-tray, global-shortcut, and background-operation capabilities.

requirements.title: Multi-window template with window management
requirements.description: When an operator selects the multi-window template, the generated Electron project shall support multiple windows and an explicit inter-window communication path.

requirements.title: Kiosk template with fullscreen and security hardening
requirements.description: When an operator selects the kiosk template, the generated Electron project shall enforce fullscreen kiosk behavior and the declared security and recovery controls.

requirements.title: Electron framework fully supported
requirements.description: The generator shall expose Electron as its sole supported desktop runtime and shall reject requests for unsupported desktop frameworks.
